items.q: Why does Pana call technique the most underrated part of strength?
items.a: You **can't lift heavy in a movement you don't understand**; fixing form took him from struggling at 120 kg to **over 2× bodyweight**.

items.q: Where should the bar sit during a squat?
items.a: **Over mid-foot**, with half your body in front of the bar line and **half behind**.

items.q: How do you stop the bar tipping you forward in a squat?
items.a: **Drive the bar back** into your upper back with wrists and elbows and **lock it before descending**.

items.q: Why practise with a thumbless grip?
items.a: Pressing the thumbs over the bar helps you **feel the bar blocked behind you** before switching back.

items.q: Why is the bench bar path diagonal?
items.a: Leg drive **pushes backwards** toward your head, so the bar should travel **back, not straight up**.

items.q: What grip stops the wrist rolling on bench?
items.a: Set the bar **low in the palm** and **twist it in with the thumb** to wedge it.

items.q: How can you spot wrist roll during a set?
items.a: Watch the **plate lettering**: if it rotates, the **bar is rolling in your hand**.

items.q: What is the most common beginner deadlift setup error?
items.a: **Squatting the deadlift**: hips too low and **shoulders behind the bar**.

items.q: How do you set up a strong deadlift?
items.a: **Hinge**: hands on hips, push hips back, keep **shoulders slightly in front of the bar** on a tripod foot.
